findings.title: Incomplete workflow-continuity contract
findings.earliest_detectable: Original 0.1.x design; unmistakable during the 0.2.0 review on 2026-08-25.
evidence: No required durable open transaction, settled gates, permitted transitions, replacement recovery, or executor classification.

control_expectation.contain: limit claims to bounded diagnostic continuity
control_expectation.recover: reconstruct state and transition from protected records

findings.consequence: A durable institutional ledger surrounded an implicit conversational scheduler.

findings.title: No independent regression against the literal 0.2.0 implementation contract
evidence: PR #52 implemented the narrower bounded-recovery invariant it declared; universal crash recovery was not specified.

control_expectation.detect: separate omitted requirements from code nonconformance

findings.consequence: Calling this only an implementation bug would conceal the requirements defect.

findings.title: Continuity remained prose-level
evidence: Validators check phrases and immutable identity, not interruption, replacement, or incomplete-transaction behavior.

control_expectation.prevent: pair behavioral claims with executable acceptance
control_expectation.recover: require durable state at invocation end

findings.consequence: Green CI proved documentary integrity, not crash-recoverable execution.

findings.title: 0.2.0 adoption omitted dependent current-state surfaces
findings.earliest_detectable: PR #54 candidate diff before merge on 2026-08-25.
evidence: PR #54 changed adoption/schema/tests but omitted status JSON, README, status coherence, and MATH-PROGRAMME guide.

control_expectation.detect: compare authoritative and projected current state

findings.consequence: Protected sources answer the effective-version question differently.

findings.title: Status coherence accepted a stale self-consistent snapshot
evidence: ci/status_coherence.py validates evidence selected inside the 0.1.1 projection and does not compare the live adoption path.

control_expectation.prevent: anchor selection to authoritative current path

findings.consequence: Status-coherence success did not establish current coherence.
findings.existing_controls_should_have_prevented: YES; THIS WAS THE CONTROL'S DECLARED PURPOSE

findings.title: Diagnostic recovery omitted durable cross-session resumption
evidence: The guide defines diagnostic/replay ladders but not open-transaction, termination, replacement, or coordinator recovery state.

control_expectation.contain: never leave next transition only in chat
control_expectation.recover: identify complete/incomplete work from protected state

findings.consequence: Continuation could still depend on one bounded invocation.

findings.title: No executor-topology admission
findings.earliest_detectable: Before admitting long-running externally gated work; certainly before 0.2.0.
evidence: No rule derives executor suitability from persistence, external waits, role graph, or transaction topology.

control_expectation.contain: do not make a bounded agent sole scheduler

findings.consequence: Agents undertook workflows whose completion horizon they could not guarantee.

findings.title: Bounded conversation is a known constraint, not a GitHub persistence failure
evidence: GitHub preserved protected commits, checks, reviews, admission, and adoption; conversational persistence remained unavailable.

control_expectation.prevent: treat bounded execution as fixed constraint

findings.consequence: Future execution commitments exceeded guaranteed executor capability.

findings.title: Protected projections disagree with active 0.2.0 adoption
findings.earliest_detectable: PR #54 preparation and immediate protected readback.
evidence: Adoption says 0.2.0; status JSON says 0.1.1; README, standard front matter, ADR, and programme guide remain stale.
findings.consequence: Fresh operators may select superseded authority from protected documentation.

findings.title: Actor separation is not fully attributable in durable evidence
findings.earliest_detectable: PR #54 merge gate and again before PR #57 merge.
evidence: PR #54 has no review; fyremael is author and merger. PR #57 has exact-head approval by jimsteeg but fyremael is author and merger; shared identity cannot prove human-versus-agent actor.

control_expectation.prevent: distinct attributable actors and scoped delegation
control_expectation.recover: retain attribution discrepancy for governance disposition

findings.consequence: Bytes and approval are provable; claimed actor topology is not.
